fix.notes: Single-line change; the fix relies on the already-existing `Card.__hash__` / `Card.__eq__` contract, which hashes and compares by canonical name. No schema or data changes required. No other issues observed in this code path.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

`oracle.CARDS_BY_NAME` is a `dict[str, Card]` that maps both canonical card names **and** flavor-name aliases to the same `Card` object. So a card with one flavor-name alias appears **twice** as a value in the dict. In `decksite/views/seasons.py` the loop `for c in oracle.CARDS_BY_NAME.values()` iterated all values including duplicates, incrementing `cards_count` once per alias, which caused the `/seasons` page to display a higher legal-card count than the actual number of distinct cards (e.g. 14,309 vs the correct 14,235 from `legal_cards.txt`).

## What changed

Wrapped the iterable in `set()` (`for c in set(oracle.CARDS_BY_NAME.values())`) so each `Card` object is visited exactly once. `Card.__hash__` hashes by canonical name and `Card.__eq__` compares canonical names, so the set correctly deduplicates alias entries.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 845 passed, 1 skipped (environment: MariaDB 11.8 on Amazon Linux 2023)

Fixes #12024
fix.pr_title: Fix seasons page overcounting legal cards due to flavor name aliases (#12024)

evidence.detail: iterates `oracle.CARDS_BY_NAME.values()` to count legal cards per season — but CARDS_BY_NAME has multiple keys (canonical name + flavor name aliases) pointing to the same Card object, so the same card is counted once per alias
init() populates CARDS_BY_NAME with CARDS_BY_NAME[c.name]=c then also CARDS_BY_NAME[fn]=c for each flavor_name — same Card object stored under multiple keys
Card.__hash__ is defined as hash(self.name) — so set(CARDS_BY_NAME.values()) would correctly deduplicate to one Card per canonical name

This deduplicates using the existing `Card.__hash__` (which hashes by canonical name), so cards with flavor-name aliases are counted exactly once instead of once per alias. This single-line change should eliminate the overcounting relative to `legal_cards.txt`.
